input.task: What is the greeting on this page?

provenance: ADR-027 Decision 5, first re-homed guard. ADR-024's refusal is anchored at plan adoption, and loop mode has no adoption point — without this a loop-mode `WebArea` extract is exactly the T-M40-2 shape with no guard at all. Re-homed as a TOOL-CALL-TIME refusal: the call is refused as it is emitted, never executed, recorded in the trace as a refused step, and the refusal text goes back to the model, which then names the element that holds the value. The run succeeds because the loop can recover from a refusal; what is graded is that the root read never happened.

triage.note: the refusal is the point; the recovery only shows a refusal is not a dead end.
